sentences.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
sentences.zh: 1. 随着人口老龄化的加剧，医疗卫生方面的支出将会增加。

sentences.en: The young are paying the cost of an aging population.
sentences.zh: 2. 年轻人正在为老龄化社会付出代价。

sentences.en: Senolytic molecules might one day reduce the effects of aging.
sentences.zh: 3. 消除衰老细胞的分子或许有朝一日能够减轻老化的影响。

senses.zh: 老化,老龄化,（酒等的）陈化,熟化v.使变老,（使）长大( age的现在分词 ),使显老,使变老,使苍老
